methods.percentile: nearest rank, seconds unless labeled otherwise
methods.head_feedback: earliest matching in-window workflow creation for exact latest PR head -> first all-success state across all attempts, choosing latest-started check/context at each candidate completion. No push timestamp or observed full-policy readiness.
methods.head_sample: 80 systematic evenly spaced PR numbers from updated base-devel population; all same-repository. Three no exact run matches excluded. Survivor bias disclosed; all attempt outcomes reported separately.
methods.ui_supplement: Five frontend-titled PRs selected before reading outcomes; separate table, excluded from headline statistics. Same retained precedence classifier.
methods.runner_occupancy: completed assigned positive runner_id intervals, clipped to window. All core run jobs; other workflows busy samples only. Lower bound.
methods.remote_cost: originating invocationLinkType=1 completed records only, includes retries; worker intervals overlap; never add to runner seconds
methods.privacy: No raw payloads/logs/profiles/syscall traces/account identity values or encrypted-input filenames published. Reviewed numeric excerpts only.
